tokens.name: color-action-default
tokens.usage: The engine’s primary seed itself (--ig-primary-seed), not a fitted shade. Every action: primary CTA fill (label `color-action-on`), in-page links and eyebrows on `color-surface-page` and `color-surface-tint`. Contrast 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.8:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.8:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`.

tokens.name: color-action-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover on light surfaces (colour shift only, no underline). Contrast 5.4:1 on `color-surface-page`.

tokens.name: color-action-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Filled-button hover: the primary fill darkens to this and nothing else changes.

tokens.name: color-action-active
tokens.usage: Inline link press state on light surfaces. Contrast 8.8:1 on `color-surface-page`.

tokens.name: color-action-on
